prayerExcerpt.en-US: Being made imitators of the Lord's Passion, we may merit to be co-heirs of his Kingdom.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Sendo imitadores da paixão do Senhor, mereçamos participar do seu Reino.

meta.face: A lean old monk of about seventy with a long, narrow face and high cheekbones, a straight, fine nose, a long, full white beard falling to the chest and a white moustache, heavy white brows, and eyes lowered and almost closed in recollection; the hood shadows the forehead, no hair visible.
meta.basis: No picture was taken in life; his standard image comes from the 1950 photograph at Annaya in which the old monks recognised him: a long white beard, black hood and downcast eyes. He died in 1898 at seventy; Wikipedia gives habit and prayer rope as his attributes.
